<!-- Source page: Obsidian -->

[**Obsidian**](https://obsidian.md) is a proprietary closed-source note-taking app and text editor, that supports <a href="Wikipedia:Markdown" class="wikilink" title="Markdown">Markdown</a> and <a href="Wikipedia:LaTeX" class="wikilink" title="LaTeX">LaTeX</a>. It is the more popular equivalent to the open-source <a href="Logseq" class="wikilink" title="Logseq">Logseq</a>.

## Installation

Obsidian can be installed from nixpkgs:

``` nix
environment.systemPackages = with pkgs; [
  obsidian
];
```
